title: Q3 Pipeline Review
note: 結構良好、輪流發言、無重疊：對應 README 品質矩陣的 85-92% 區間

utterances.speaker: David Okonkwo
utterances.text: Good morning everyone. Thirty minutes, three topics: onboarding, the launch date, and the vendor SOW.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I will send the revised onboarding checklist to the client by Friday.

utterances.speaker: David Okonkwo
utterances.text: Marcus, can you prepare the migration risk summary before next Tuesday?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: We should probably revisit pricing at some point.

utterances.speaker: David Okonkwo
utterances.text: Decision: we are moving the launch date to 15 September.

utterances.speaker: Sofia Lindqvist
utterances.text: I'll update the launch date in the CRM this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sofia Lindqvist
utterances.text: Maybe someone could look at the analytics dashboard.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Feld
utterances.text: 我來負責整理客戶回饋，週四前給大家。

utterances.speaker: David Okonkwo
utterances.text: 我們決定沿用現有供應商，不重新招標。

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: The onboarding deck is already in the shared drive for reference.
